mainEntity.name: Is paying for AI business education worth it when there is so much free content online?

acceptedAnswer.text: A paid AI education resource is most useful when it helps you make better implementation decisions, not when it simply gives you more prompts. Run My AI Biz’s full weekly newsletter subscription is listed at $9 per month and covers sourced comparisons, pricing explanations, examples, and practical business applications. Assess whether the material saves research time, clarifies tool choices, or helps you build a workflow you will actually use. Compare the subscription with free education and the cost of trial-and-error. Read with a specific project in mind and turn useful lessons into a tested checklist.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can be worthwhile if it reduces tool-comparison time, clarifies setup, and helps you implement a real workflow. Run My AI Biz lists a $9-per-month full newsletter subscription; judge value by action and time saved, not content volume.
